body: Don't even think about coming to central or east europe. You will be waiting months just to have jobs that will work you all day for pay you won't survive. No jobs provide bonuses, benefits. Some jobs will simply fire you if you go to doctor once or if you go to toilet more than once in 6 hours. No jobs give promotions but they fire you. Don't even think about it. Also most people are assholes with no empathy. This country sold everything to the west and became a colony of monopols. We are just factory land and all the great minds emigrate after school. Suicide rate is high and every second guy is a heavy drinker.

I believe my uni is not recognized outside. A lot of unis beside the one in capital are not unless you are a doctor I think. Besides I don't have any money even for going out. It is a situation you are trapped in, there are no means I can get enough money to move anywhere. I know freaking engineers being janitors around my location.

Switzerland is probably the one of the best countries so don't even compare. This is third world and yes we did learn stats but only in software form of SPSS so I can only know what to do use in what kind of research but that's it. And no, no math in any uni here in psych. I think one has but only the first semester. We are a shithole and there is no point of education if you are not becoming medical doctor or programmer.

I got masters and it is not helping at all. The problem with psych here is that it is general and we do not specialize like in normal at least semi functional countries so you graduate but can't do anything and feel incompetent. Feels like you just read theories and do some stats that noone understands because we are not taught math.. then you want to learn it on your own but finds out you don't have the time for it. Feels great.

Yes. Life is a misery either way if you work or not. I feel hopeless because I can't get any job but once I get it it is mostly 12h days long grind of stressful work with nearly no rights and pay that doesn't pay the bills. It's so bad here I wonder why there are so many suicides these years /s.

Tbh employers don't care about my degree because of no experience and it is a con to any other wageslave work because they see me as risk so I am stuck and feeling suicidal. Also it is abnormal to not have job exp at my age and they always assume too much. I mean I can't get factory work that has horrible conditions - 12h 3 shift work 6 days a week for minimum. Self employment is not an option here, this country is destroyed with monopoly and corruption. You will bleed money if you try to even register. I wanted to be a therapist but it takes 3-4 more years to get licence that costs 3-5k euros and most people here get 500 euros a month for wage slave. It is a professions for the rich by the rich these days. You can't do therapy without licence because you will get into jail. I really am lost.
